text:
maya: Quick shoutout — huge thanks to Sam, Priya, and Facilities for the last-minute all-hands save this morning. projector + sound + coffee = ✅ :tada:

sam: lol team effort. ran the canary while Priya did ladder acrobatics :joy: — command was `./deploy --canary 10%` and everything stayed green.

priya: thanks!! I have bruises and feelings but the demo looked clean so worth it :raised_hands: special shout to @facilities for the spare HDMI cable.

jordan: Priya is officially on the hero board. also big thanks to Alex for restocking oat milk and kombucha in the kitchen — morale saved :heart: (reactions: :tada: x6)

alex: happy to help. low-key proud of our mini fridge management skills :fridge: . also cheers to Sam for staying calm during the deploy.

maria: sending props to everyone who scrambled and to whoever left the giant bag of cookies in the breakroom. you know who you are :cookie: :sparkles:

vic: can we put together a tiny thank-you lunch for Facilities? lunchbot: Poll — What should we order to thank them?

lunchbot: Poll: "Thank-you lunch for Facilities" — react with one: :one: Tacos, two: :two: Korean BBQ, three: :three: Salad bowls. Vote by reacting! (poll open 6h)

maya: placing my vote for :two: (KBBQ). also @priya let's grab a coffee later, treat's on me. :coffee:

sam: :one: from me. if tacos then extra lime pls.

maria: :three: to balance the chaos. low-sugar choices for the afternoon.

priya: :two: — and really, thanks again everyone. tiny logistics miracles make big demos happen.

maya: calling this thread a gratitude cascade — filing an official kudos card to Facilities after lunch :memo: :raised_hands:
